name: Crescentis Capital Limited
about: Crescentis Capital Limited, a non-banking finance company, engages in the investment and financing activities in India. It is also involved in the proprietary investments in stocks and securities. The company was formerly known as Som Datt Finance Corporation Limited and changed its name to Crescentis Capital Limited in January 2026. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
